@deskTrayOpen.description: Tray menu item that shows the app's window again. The app sits in the system tray (Windows notification area, Linux panel) while the window is closed and the built-in node syncs.

@deskTrayNode.description: Tray menu status line and tooltip of the built-in node. {state} is the node's state as Settings › Node says it (Off, Syncing 42%, Synced), possibly followed by its height.

@deskTrayHeight.description: Tray menu: the node's block height after its state, joined by a middle dot (Synced · height 3,104,220). Lower case.

@deskTrayEpicbox.description: Tray menu status line of the open wallet's Epicbox receiving. {state} is the state as Settings › Transactions says it (Connected · epicbox.epiccash.com, Off, Wallet locked). 'Epicbox' is a name, never translated.

deskSetNodeBackgroundNoTray: This desktop has no system tray, so closing the window quits the app.

@deskSetNodeBackgroundNoTray.description: Settings › Node: hint under Sync in background when the desktop has no system tray (GNOME without the AppIndicator extension); the switch is disabled then.
